summary.text: Joseph Johnson is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 55, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A sales consultant and first-time candidate, he says his priorities include lower taxes, economic growth, parental rights in education and safe communities.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Johnson graduated from West Leyden High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in a blue-collar family in Northlake, built a career in finance before founding a consulting business, graduated from DePaul University and briefly played college baseball.
He said he lives in Glenview and is raising four children.
Johnson advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
In the survey, he listed ending reckless spending, fostering economic growth, protecting parental rights and backing law enforcement among his key messages.
He listed the House Republican Organization and the Illinois Federation of Young Republicans among his endorsers.
